description: This file defines a PHP class 'Home' within the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Common'. The class extends a base Controller class and provides an 'index' method that sets up data for rendering the homepage, including setting page metadata and loading various common layout components such as header, footer, and columns. The file appears to be part of the OpenCart project and corresponds to the controller logic for the homepage in the catalog's common controller namespace.
